source_locks.relevant_mechanism: Span parent identity plus zero-to-many ordered Links to SpanContexts with attributes; links are tracing relationships and may cross traces

observed_mechanisms: Link carries a SpanContext and attributes; Python API documents Link attributes as immutable
Tracer.start_span accepts an ordered sequence of links
ReadableSpan exposes links as a tuple
SDK has configurable bounded link/event/attribute lists and can report dropped links
SDK contains synchronous/concurrent span processors, environment configuration and exporter-oriented runtime machinery

useful_structural_transfer: represent one evidence node with explicit immutable identity and zero-to-many typed relationship links
permit links across separate evidence traces instead of forcing one-parent tree semantics
attach relation metadata to each link rather than infer relation semantics from adjacency
non_transferable_as_authority: OpenTelemetry TraceId/SpanId are tracing correlation identifiers and may be randomly/pseudorandomly generated; they are not deterministic semantic request/broadcast identities
a parent or Link relationship is telemetry structure, not proof that a recipient semantically consumed a broadcast
a trace relationship is not model-internal causal evidence
sampling or dropped links are acceptable observability concepts but are incompatible with WP507 positive-evidence completeness unless they force UNKNOWN/fail-closed

wp507_mapping.positive_evidence_rule: The link graph may make provenance inspectable, but it MUST NOT itself promote causal evidence. WP507 positive contract-scope causal evidence still requires the existing matched control/intervention conditions: same probe_id, identical non-broadcast input digest, exact intervention broadcast binding, complete recipient-scoped uptake evidence and differing declared downstream output digest.
wp507_mapping.missing_or_dropped_link_rule: Any missing required witness link or dropped-link condition on the acceptance path yields UNKNOWN/fail-closed; no sampling-derived positive evidence.
wp507_mapping.authority_boundary: Derived/rebuildable witness only; not UnifiedDB truth, not GWT truth, not model truth and not EffectGate/EffectJournal authority.

dependency_assessment.reason: Current WP507 is a small deterministic persistence-agnostic contract and its implementation is not yet present on main. The full Python telemetry SDK adds processors, threading, exporters/configuration, dependency surface and bounded-droppable telemetry behavior that are unnecessary for the claimed component scope.
dependency_assessment.distillation_shape: A tiny immutable F2-native witness-node/link schema using deterministic F2 digests and explicit typed relation attributes; no OpenTelemetry package dependency required.

counterhypotheses: WP507 native receipts may already encode every required relationship, making even a tiny link projection redundant; measure before adopting.
If Frankenstein later requires cross-process standardized telemetry/export interop, a bounded OpenTelemetry adapter could become useful outside the acceptance authority path.

External causal packages such as pyvene/DoWhy/CITCOM may provide stronger experimental discriminators; OpenTelemetry should remain provenance scaffolding and must not compete with them as a causal method.

next_discriminator.objective: Run an F2-native E4-style ablation comparing the native receipt-only representation against the tiny deterministic witness-link projection on fail-closed completeness detection, deterministic replay equality, serialized bytes, CPU time and p50/p95 latency. Adopt only if it improves inspectability/falsifier strength without weakening exact evidence or materially increasing cost.
next_discriminator.do_not_do_now: Do not implement into WP507-owned paths while the Trigger-4 WP507 G3 worker owns those paths and source is not yet present on main.
